display.purpose: Desktop page titles and primary operational headings.

mono.purpose: Work Order numbers, IDs, deadlines, timestamps, and audit lines only.

motion.name: deadline-crossfade
motion.purpose: Deadline rail changes from planned to warning, danger, or escalation.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable shimmer and pulse; use instant state changes.
accessibility.statusRule: Status, category, and deadline must include text and icon; color is supplemental.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear execution action for Assign, Submit, Approve, or the next permitted step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0C6B58; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 40px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #0C6B58; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #095445; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0C6B58; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Order Row
components.description: Dense operational queue row with deadline rail, Work Order identity, category, status, and deadline proximity.
components.css: .ds-wo-row { min-height: 56px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D5DCE5; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; } .deadline-rail { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #B86E00; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Text-first status marker with an icon and semantic color support.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #15202B; background: #F7F9FB; border: 1px solid #D5DCE5; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: Before-and-after evidence area for field submission and HOD verification.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; background: #F7F9FB; border: 1px solid #D5DCE5; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-evidence { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview: OptiWorks is a light, high-contrast dispatch board for facility work. It uses operational density, clear borders, restrained neutrals, and scarce signal colors to make queues, evidence, and SLA risk legible at a glance. Modern minimalism comes from removing competing decoration while preserving every state needed to complete and audit work.
keyCharacteristics: Role-shaped work queues instead of a generic dashboard
Status, category, and deadline shown as a text-icon-color trio
Evidence capture and verification treated as core workflow
Responsive field-first mobile and HOD-first desktop behavior

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Signal colors belong to urgency, SLA, escalation, category, or outcome. They never become decoration.

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Every Work Order and Daily Work item communicates status, category, and deadline proximity through label text, icon, and color.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Lists use borders and tonal layering; shadows are reserved for transient overlays.

dos: Do keep primary actions explicit and permission-driven.
Do design empty, loading, error, success, disabled, and offline states with the main flow.
Do use Bahasa Indonesia for user-facing operational copy.
Do respect keyboard focus, reduced motion, ARIA patterns, and minimum touch targets.
donts: Don't use purple SaaS gradients, neon dark mode, glow edges, or decorative washes.
Don't use card-soup dashboards, generic metric heroes, gamification, or consumer pill CTAs.
Don't rely on color alone for status or use red versus green as the only pass/fail signal.
Don't turn the first screen into a marketing landing page; show the user's work queue.
